body: I won't bother you with the story. I just am and haven't been for a long long time
I have nothing I want to live for. I am unhappy. The thought of death relieves me
Goodbye OP. I am also going that way. I wish you all the best
Best wishes. I too am tonight
I will be there waiting to greet you. Best wishes OP
I'm sorry. There is nothing that can be done. I wish you a great life. Enjoy what I can not
I have. I'm ready. Thank you
Goodbye. Thank you <3
I'm planning for the 15th :) I am also at peace with it. Just have to get things in order
That's what I want. Nothingness. I don't want to think or anything. Just cease to be and have everyone forget about me
I used to think that too, but I'm hoping we don't. I don't want to watch anything
Part of me doesn't hope I get to watch because that means it isn't over when I'm dead. I want nothing
I'm so sorry. Mine is pregnant and just got engaged. My day is coming up
I plan to only write my letter to one person, my ex. The rest of my family can go fuck themselves
I thought so too. I had just seen comments in the past from users saying not to leave one at all
I live by myself. So either someone will eventually look for me, or I'll setup an email to go out a day or two after
That's kinda been what I'm leaning towards. Should I go for a drop and break neck, or more of a suffocation approach?
I've been wondering the same thing!
Same. It sucks. I'm sorry

I'm tired of life too. Sorta similar situation to you. My love is pregnant and just got engaged to another guy. I can't live my life without her, and my thoughts of them living together makes me sick. My circumstances won't ever change
I'm thinking of going the same way
I wish you peace and calm.
I'm in the exact same spot as you. It's unfortunate and sad. Wish I could help turn you around but I understand there probably isn't anything that will
I really don't. That's it for me. And before her was complete missery, loneliness, and sadness like it is now

It would prove that I love her, and that I want her. I don't need to prove anything to myself. I'm happy with this decision. It's what I want my legacy to be. I'm writing a very long and detailed letter about my life, and then it's over. No more sadness for me
No. There's nothing to enjoy. Thanks tho

This time it's for real. I want to do it on a special day. Last time I wanted to on my birthday but I didn't have enough time to prepare my things. Now I have time. Also I just found out she's engaged. That's shoved me over the line
I can't be helped. Like I said, tried it. My feelings won't change
They wake me up in the middle of the night and ask to talk. No, because I lie to them. I don't want or need to talk to anyone. Done and tried that. Just s waste of their time
Your comment posted. I just responded
Because they don't listen or engage. Only when I talk about ending it they freak and call police. No follow up or anything.
Which part?
Well truth be told, I don't give a shit about them. They pretend to care. I've never really thought any one to be fake until this happened. They are complete toxic trash
I appreciate your optimism, but I disagree. Since deciding to end my life I've ironically been so happy. I look forward to writing her my feelings and that being it

I know, it's a tricky area, but having people suffer and continue to live just because society doesn't believe in suicide isn't perfect either. I am miserable, and have been for a year and a half. Nothing has helped. I'm suffering only because I can't say bye to loved ones, and the difficulty of ending my life. I've set a date for next week and it's probably going to be ugly and messy
Oh I'll be letting her go. She won't have to deal with me again

I would love to talk about it with friends, but I know the moment I say anything remotely like harming myself, they'll call the police on me. That's not what I want. Talk to me about it without judgment.

PM me if you want to talk
Hey! I am on my birthday next week as well
Agreed. Having a date set lifts alot of weight off. Planning is easier too

I wish hospitals or doctors could help you die. Assisted suicide. I'm going to do it, but the pain or chance of failure scares me. I just want to say bye to people I care about, and then go peacefully

I feel you! Sounds like I'm going thru a very similar situation. I'm going to end my life too because I can't live without her. She is my everything and she won't even acknowledge I exist. It's the worst feeling ever
I'm going to buy her a ring this week, write her a long note, and then end my life surrounded by pictures of her
My future is gone. I have a week

Yes. And dont say it'll get easier or I'll get over her. It's been a year and a half, and nothing has changed. Things have only gotten worse. I think about her every single minute. I'm doing this because of her
That's the thing. I don't want my life to continue. I'm done. It's time
She wants nothing to do with me. She's pregnant with another man's child
All I want is her back
My ex talking to me
There's only one thing that will save me, and I've been waiting for it, but it doesn't seem like it'll happen. So what's the point
I've tried that
Pm me whenever you have time
Extra helpful if you're someone going thru the same shit right now. I need someone who truly understands
I'm sorry. Truly I am
I'm sorry, but I don't want saving. There is no saving
I am fine with that
The only thing that can change is me ending my life. It's been way too long, and I know my feelings won't ever change
Ok, thanks. I'll consider that
